title: Crispy Dutch Pork Bitterballen
description: A crispy, earthy Dutch dish featuring emulsified pork, perfect for snacking or as an appetizer. These bitterballen are also vegan-friendly when using a plant-based manteca alternative.
instructions: Combine pork shoulder, onion, carrot, cloves, nutmeg, salt, and black pepper in a food processor. Process until the mixture is well combined and slightly smooth.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in the manteca alternative until fully incorporated.
Gradually add the flour and bread crumbs to the bowl, mixing until the mixture forms a thick paste.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
When ready to fry, heat a deep frying pan or a deep fryer to 350°F (175°C).
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the mixture into the hot oil and fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the bitterballen from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the bitterballen warm, garnished with chopped parsley or chives and a side of your favorite dipping sauce.
For an extra crispy coating, roll the fried bitterballen in a mixture of flour, cornstarch, and a pinch of salt before serving.
